verdict.rationale: Veriff documents a broad set of official SDKs: native Android and iOS, React Native, a Flutter plugin, a JS SDK, and an InContext web SDK. Each has platform requirements, NFC callbacks, customization options and migration guides. The SDKs are mainly front-end verification-flow clients; backend work goes through the REST API. Missing for 10: evidence of server-side language SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Bring the end-user to verification flow using web or native SDKs
Main guide to the cross-platform solution for iOS and Android with React Native.
Veriff Flutter Plugin requires the project to target: iOS minimum version 13.0 or higher, Android minimum version 8.0 (api 26) or higher
The purpose of the JS SDK is to create the session URL for your end-user's verification session.
Veriff Android SDK needs your minSdkVersion to be of 26 or above
Veriff iOS SDK requires at least iOS version 15.0
